messages:
alex: Heads up — I found a gap in hourly agg counts for EU between 2026-11-03T03:00Z and 2026-11-03T06:00Z. ~12k missing rows in aggregates table when comparing raw events vs agg-hours. Likely late mobile SDK retries.
lena: ugh. any idea if it's full-day or just those hours?
alex: just those hours from the mobile cluster in eu-west-1. Ingest shows normal raw event arrivals but our agg pipeline didn't finish for those partitions.
dom: could be a downstream runner oom or a parquet write flake. logs?
alex: pasted small tail from runner logs:
```
2026-11-03T04:12:08Z ERROR runner.process PartitionWriteError: aborted writing parquet s3://redwood-telemetry/eu/2026/11/03/03/*.parquet
Caused by: ConnectionResetError
```
sanjay: network retries + transient S3 rate limits are my bet. We shouldn't full-recompute unless we have to.
lena: agree. prefer targeted backfill on affected hour partitions.
dom: plan: rehydrate partitions for those three hours only, run agg-recompute with kv-cache disabled, limit concurrency to avoid thundering.
alex: sounds good. what's the command? anyone can trigger?
dom: airflow trigger_dag recompute-agg-hours --conf '{"start":"2026-11-03T03:00:00Z","end":"2026-11-03T06:00:00Z","disable_kv_cache":true,"max_concurrency":3,"tags":["ingest-gap-hunt"]}'
lena: add note to the run: "reason=eu-mobile-late-ingest" so ops metrics pick it up.
sanjay: also set cost_quota:bypass=false in conf so Billing/Quota team sees the usage spike.
telemetry-bot: Last recompute run for agg-hours: 2026-11-02T22:45:00Z status=success rows=1,234,567 duration=00:18:12
ops-bot: Current S3 partition sizes (eu): 2026/11/03/03 -> 12.1MB, 04 -> 0.0MB (empty), 05 -> 0.0MB (empty)
alex: ok will kick off recompute now, running it in canary mode on a single worker first then scale to 3.
alex: (triggered) dag_run_id=manual__2026-11-07T15:12:00Z
dom: monitor the commit logs in hive and watch for duplicate-keys. We should dedupe by event_id on write.
lena: also double-check dashboard rollups — some of our infra dashboards aggregate across hourly buckets, they may double-count while we reingest. I’ll mute alert rule:agg-hours-mismatch for 2h.
sanjay: set replay-priority to "low" so it doesn't steal capacity from live traffic.
ops-bot: Noted — adjusted cluster autoscale thresholds and set replay-priority header.
telemetry-bot: Run update: recompute-agg-hours dag_run manual__2026-11-07T15:12:00Z status=running step=repartition
dom: if the job hits parquet write errors again, fallback is to write to temp prefix + atomic rename. I can push that helper in the runner quickly.
alex: thanks — can you prep the rename-path patch? if we hit errors we'll enable it mid-run.
dom: will do, ~20m.
telemetry-bot: Run update: step=write-partitions status=partial_success failures=2 partitions_failed=[2026-11-03T04:00:00Z,2026-11-03T05:00:00Z]
alex: failures match earlier empties. requeued just the two hours with max_concurrency=1 to be safe.
lena: alerted downstream consumers to ignore transient mismatches; muted agg-hours-mismatch alert.
sanjay: after those succeed, we should run a cheap validation: compare raw_event_counts by event_type against agg-hours totals for those windows.
dom: validation script:
```
python tools/validate_agg.py --start 2026-11-03T03:00Z --end 2026-11-03T06:00Z --mode=fast
```
alex: validation passed for 03 and 06, 04 and 05 passed after retry. final counts reconciled.
telemetry-bot: Run update: status=success rows_recomputed=12,014 duration=00:25:43
alex: closing this thread. filed follow-up: ticket TELEM-4987 to add atomic-temp-write and increase S3 client retries for runner. thanks all :thumbsup:
lena: nice work everyone :rocket:
sanjay: good call on targeted run. saved a lot of cost.
dom: added PR for rename fallback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/729
ops-bot: Closure note: cluster autoscale thresholds returned to default."
